title: proposal.v1
description: The human gate for external VCS actions. An agent routine never touches GitHub: it EMITS a Proposal (what it wants done + why), a HUMAN decides it, and a separate credentialed executor performs only approved proposals. Levels are STRUCTURALLY bound to actions: L2 (comment|label|close|open_issue — annotate, batch-approvable) and L3 (push_branch|open_pr — mutate, per-action approval ONLY). Credentials and the gate sit on opposite sides of the agent (P15): the worker holds no GitHub token, the token-holder executes nothing un-approved — a prompt-injected unit can at worst ASK.

Routine.description: The emitting routine + the access level it was AUTHORED with. A proposal above its routine's declared_access is rejected at emission (fail-closed).

declared_access.description: the routine's authored access ceiling — L1 read-only, L2 annotate, L3 mutate

Origin.description: Which dispatch emitted this — the audit anchor back to the unit.

trigger.description: the unit.v1 trigger that fired it (event|scheduled|message|transcription)

event_ref.description: opaque ref to the triggering event/source, if any

Target.description: WHERE the action would land — a provider object, never a credential.

number.description: issue/PR number when kind is issue|pr

ref.description: branch/tag ref when kind is branch

Patch.description: One file change an L3 proposal carries — a unified diff or a full-file content.

Payload.description: WHAT the action carries, per action: comment → comment; label → labels; close → optional comment; open_issue → title/body/labels; push_branch → branch/patches/base; open_pr → branch/patches/base + title/body.

comment.description: comment body (comment; optional closing note on close)

branch.description: the branch the patches land on

base.description: the base ref the branch/PR forks from

DecisionRecord.description: The human decision stamped onto the proposal.

ExecutionRecord.description: What the (credentialed, separate) executor did with an approved proposal.

Proposal.description: One proposed external action. level↔action is a STRUCTURAL binding (the allOf below), not data: an L2 proposal cannot carry a mutating action, and vice versa.

subject.description: identity.v1 subject = the person whose routine proposes (and who decides)

rationale.description: WHY — the model's case, shown to the approving human

Decision.description: A batch decision over pending proposals. The decide surface REFUSES any L3 id in a batch — L3 is per-action only (the /{id}/approve path).
